sv.title: Alzecure Pharma utser Johan Sandin till permanent vd
sv.summary: Forskningsbolaget Alzecure Pharma har utsett Johan Sandin till permanent vd. Han har varit tillförordnad vd sedan den 27 oktober och var dessförinnan forskningschef.

en.title: Alzecure Pharma appoints Johan Sandin as permanent CEO
en.summary: Research company Alzecure Pharma has appointed Johan Sandin as permanent CEO. He has been acting CEO since 27 October and was previously research director.
